name: 🍌 Banana Egg Pancakes
what: Pancakes made from blended banana, eggs and oats.

core.name: Ripe bananas
core.out: no bananas: make regular pancakes or see Plan B

core.name: Eggs
core.out: no eggs: this one needs them

extras: berries, vanilla yogurt, maple syrup, cinnamon, baking powder

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Blend 3 bananas, 6 eggs, ½ cup oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Rest it.
Butter a nonstick pan on medium-low.
Small pancakes, about 3 inches. Flip when the edges look set and bubbles show.

key: Keep them small and let the batter rest, or they fall apart.
done: Golden on both sides and springy in the middle.
plan_b: Pancakes falling apart? Scramble the batter in the pan: banana "French toast" bites.
